summary: Iter-163 verified 5 focused items after iter-158n scoping fixes. Backend: 5/6 new tests pass + 37/37 iter-158/160 regressions pass (1 pre-existing wallet-topup skip). PASS: pending-cash/partials mess-scoping (admin impersonate two messes returns properly scoped rows; no leakage across messes verified via /api/admin/messes/{id}/users), new POST /admin/partial-payments/reset endpoint (dry_run + anon-403), and content mess-scoping (GET /api/content/footer with ?mess_id=X returns the mess-scoped brand_name marker while anonymous GET returns global default). FAIL: takeaway-pendency manual-insert row is inserted with mess_id=null even when admin is actively impersonating a mess — the caller-mess resolution helpers (`_resolve_target_mess` in routes/tiffin_stock.py and `effective_mess_id` in server.py) DO NOT read the admin's impersonate_mess_id from user_sessions; they only handle mess_owner + explicit as_mess_id param. The row still appears in GET list only because with mess_id=null the list falls back to global (user_ids=None), not because the OR-clause fix worked. Frontend: /login on mobile 480x900 — 'One step away' delivery banner is CORRECTLY absent. However, the login-form-card is 496.2px tall (way above the <320px target). The card contents (mess picker + phone + name + Continue + privacy + powered-by footer) legitimately can't fit in 320px, so the <320px threshold appears unrealistic vs the current UI content.

critical.issue: When called by admin actively impersonating a mess, the inserted pendency doc gets mess_id=null (not the impersonated mess_id). Root cause: `_resolve_target_mess(user, None)` in /app/backend/routes/tiffin_stock.py:137 returns None for admins regardless of impersonation state. Fix: mirror the pattern in subscription_payment.py — check db.user_sessions for impersonate_mess_id when user.role=='admin'. Same helper is imported by app_cms.py L281,536,547 → also breaks stock accounting & list-scoping.

minor.issue: Underlying `effective_mess_id(admin_user, None)` returns None, so admin+impersonating actually gets GLOBAL takeaway list, not the impersonated mess's. Manual rows appear only by accident (global scope), not by the intended $or clause. Same root cause as above.

ui_bugs.issue: login-form-card measured 496.2px tall (goal was <320px). Content — mess dropdown + phone input + name input + Continue button + privacy line + powered-by footer — genuinely cannot compress under 320px. Either move powered-by/privacy outside the card or accept a higher threshold (~500px).

issues: A red marquee near the top of the viewport shows the tagline 'India's first Fully technologically advanced user management software…' repeatedly — this is a different banner than the removed 'One step away' one and works fine, just noting for context.

action_items: FIX takeaway-pendency mess-scoping for admin+impersonating: patch `_resolve_target_mess` (tiffin_stock.py) and/or `effective_mess_id` (server.py) to read `impersonate_mess_id` from db.user_sessions for admin role, matching the pattern already used in subscription_payment.py `admin_pending_cash`/`admin_pending_partials`. This is the same class of bug the round-158n fix was supposed to eliminate.
Reconsider the <320px login-form-card height goal — with 3 inputs + CTA + policy links the minimum is ~450–500px; either drop the powered-by footer OR relax the threshold.
critical_code_review_comments: Two helpers (`effective_mess_id` in server.py L5191 and `_resolve_target_mess` in routes/tiffin_stock.py L137) both compute a caller-scope mess_id but neither of them honors admin impersonation. Meanwhile `subscription_payment.py` inlines the impersonation lookup 3 times (L286, L574, L607, L641). Consider extracting a single canonical helper `caller_scope_mess_id(user)` that handles mess_owner + admin-impersonating + staff.mess_id, and use it EVERYWHERE. Current split is the direct cause of iter-158n's manual-pendency scoping regression.
In app_cms.py L508-539 the swallowed `except Exception: pass` on `_resolve_target_mess` masks the very bug we just found — a warning log would make this visible earlier.

rca of the issue: Round 158n added mess-scoping for pending-cash, pending-partials, partial-payments/reset — all three routes inline their own read of `db.user_sessions.impersonate_mess_id` for admin role. However the sibling takeaway-pendency manual + collect + list routes rely on the OLDER helpers `_resolve_target_mess` (routes/tiffin_stock.py) and `effective_mess_id` (server.py L5191), neither of which was updated to read impersonation state. So for admin+impersonating callers: (a) manual insert stores mess_id=None instead of the impersonated mess, (b) the list route computes mid=None and returns global scope, and the row is visible only by that accident. Mitigation: patch the two helpers to read `impersonate_mess_id` for admin sessions (parallel to the inlined logic in subscription_payment.py L286).
